subject: 赵州陀罗尼经幢 · 七级石经幢
author: ScareCriterion12
source_note: ScareCriterion12于2020年拍摄，文件名为2021上传年份。按实际层段与残损绘制，经文仅作浅淡纹理，不作为释文。
prompt: Draw the exact Zhao County Northern Song Dharani stone pillar from the second photo, isolated full height, using the first Longmen line master only for style. Not a generic pagoda: this is a sculpted slender OCTAGONAL STONE COLUMN built of alternating carved projecting canopies, lotus pedestals and inscribed shafts. Trace the observed sequence carefully from low polygonal stepped pedestal through broad carved base, the first tall shaft, its large square/octagonal fringed canopy with beast-head supports and lotus ring, second long inscribed shaft, next carved canopy/lotus ring, third shorter shaft and canopy, small carved upper shrine/cap and lotus with pointed finial. Preserve exactly the photograph's sequence, proportions and uneven weathering, including actual stone losses below the lower shaft and iron fastening wires where seen. No extra repeated pagoda roofs or invented restoration. Remove the foreground modern stone bridge/railings, street, trees, people and metal fence; retain just the monument's own stepped pedestal. Simplify carved friezes and inscription to very sparse short marks, do not write fake legible text. Full portrait 1024x1536, whole monument comfortably within white margins. Quiet very fine black contour on pure white, no grey tone, no hatching, no filled black interiors. Maintain the master drawing's thin elegant airy line quality.

site_recommendation.name: 赵州陀罗尼经幢
site_recommendation.lede: 八角幢身、华盖与莲瓣层层相叠，赵州经幢像一座用经文与雕刻组成的石塔。原开元寺已不存，经幢仍立在城中街口。
facts: 经幢建于北宋景祐五年（1038），平面八角，共七级。
幢身刻经文，盖、座之间布置佛像、飞天与莲瓣等雕刻。
图版按现存石幢绘制，保留局部残损，不与赵县柏林寺塔或正定开元寺混为一处。
